notes: Site is behind Akamai Bot Manager (behavioral JS challenge); direct HTTP (requests/curl_cffi, incl. session-cookie warmup) and headless/stealth Playwright were both blocked on /shop/ paths (only the bare homepage returned 200 via curl_cffi). No Claude-specific robots.txt disallow found, so proceeded to Claude-in-Chrome (real browser), which passed the challenge after a short wait. Discovered the full seasonal taxonomy via the 'Holiday' hub (/shop/holiday/ho0393, Home dept) which lists 10 Departments: Christmas, Easter, Fall Harvest, Gift Wrap & Accessories, Halloween, Hanukkah, Mardi Gras, Patriotic Decor, St. Patrick's Day, Valentine's Day - each visited directly to confirm own exact qty and check for further children. Christmas, Fall Harvest and Halloween have genuine sub-department children (Indoor/Outdoor/Trees/Lights/etc, all confirmed leaves with only filter facets below them - Christmas Trees and Indoor Decor checked directly); their parent nodes are kept as grouping rows (qty/link null) since children are subsets with partial overlap (parent total < sum of children), per the shared overlap rule. 'Gift Wrap & Accessories' (9 items) mixes Christmas, Easter and non-holiday Birthday products under one Holiday-department node - kept with the site's own name and flagged rather than assigned to one holiday. Excluded as duplicate/overlap: /shop/holiday-storage/ho0307 ('Holiday Storage', 17 items, filed under Storage & Organization dept, breadcrumb Home>Storage & Organization>Holiday Storage) - same Christmas-tree-storage-bag product set already captured as Christmas > Storage (/shop/christmas-storage/ho0431, 18 items). Investigated and excluded as non-categories: 'Baby' (1), "Mother's Day" (1) and 'Pride' (5) which appear in the Home department's 'Holiday and Season' facet sidebar but resolved to cross-department FILTER results (e.g. /shop/baby-home/ho-32677 breadcrumbs to Home>Holiday>Christmas Decorations FILTERED BY Baby; /shop/mothers-day-home/ho-3428 to Home>Home Decor>Home Accents FILTERED BY Mother's Day; /shop/pride-home/ho-22789 spans Garden & Outdoors/Holiday/Home Decor/Rugs) rather than genuine standalone seasonal PLPs with their own department entry - these are attribute filters, not categories. No room-name overrides applied. All qty values are the site's own 'X to Y of N items' PLP counts, cross-checked against the Holiday hub's Departments facet counts where applicable (all matched exactly).
